title: AnimationPlayer - Node Track Groups reorder themselves confusingly when deleting tracks
body:
### Tested versions

4.3.stable
Master - Godot v4.4.beta (a63a8b430)

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta (a63a8b430) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When deleting tracks while in the "Group tracks by Node" view, it may cause the track groups to reorder themselves. This is very confusing if you have a lot of tracks you are working with as they might completely disappear from your view as they move.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e3d76b3-deed-49d5-8d18-8441adab44ce

This appears to happen because the location of the group is based on the first tracks position in the animation. But it would be good if this could be solved by caching the order until the scene or animation player is reopened to make it less confusing for the user.

**Note:** I'm not certain if it's correct to log this as a bug or if I should log it as a feature request. Let me know if a feature request is preferred.

### Steps to reproduce

Add tracks that are intertwined between different nodes and start deleting the tracks from the top and notice how the groups jump. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[track-delete-reorder.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18847967/track-delete-reorder.zip)
